title: Victoria Wine Tour with Wine Tastings and Charcuterie
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join an amazing 5-hour winery tour in Victoria, where you'll visit three of the top wineries of the Cowichan Valley. Your package includes private tastings and samples, round trip transportation from downtown Victoria.

Please note:
-The venues on our tours may vary depending on availability.
-A minimum of 4 guests is required for public tours. If fewer than 4 people are booked, we may need to reschedule.
